description:

Navigate to the product edit page for 'Dell XPS 13 Laptop' and add the following two variations:

1. High Performance Model:
   - Title: 'Dell XPS 13 - 16GB/512GB'
   - SKU: 'DELL-XPS13-16-512'
   - Price: $1,249.99

2. Ultra Performance Model:
   - Title: 'Dell XPS 13 - 32GB/1TB'
   - SKU: 'DELL-XPS13-32-1TB'
   - Price: $1,599.99

Both variations must be enabled (published) and saved to the product. Do not modify the existing base model.
